afterLines:
- name: Observe the selected VS bundled Clang pair without changing acceptance
      id: bundled-clang-probe
      if: "!cancelled() && env.OPENGEUL_SUITE_RUN_MODE == 'acceptance' && matrix.architecture == 'x64' && steps.suite-unit-shell.outcome == 'success' && steps.native31-privacy-prepare.outcome == 'success' && steps.fixtures.outcome == 'success'"
      shell: pwsh
      timeout-minutes: 2
      run: |
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
        $vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio/Installer/vswhere.exe'
        $hostPython = (Get-Command python -ErrorAction Stop).Source
        python -B suite/e2e/vs_bundled_clang_probe.py --suite ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($env:SUITE_PACKAGE)) --windows $env:SystemRoot --vswhere $vswhere --host-python $hostPython --expected-suite-source-commit $env:GITHUB_SHA --output ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath('.work/suite-bundled-clang-probe-private')) --report ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath('.work/suite-bundled-clang-probe-public/report.numeric.json')) --cached-preparation ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath('.work/suite-calc-save/ascii-message-observer/preparation.json'))
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Read-only bundled compiler observation is incomplete; acceptance is unchanged.' }
    - name: Validate the closed bundled Clang observation before upload
      id: bundled-clang-report
      if: "always() && env.OPENGEUL_SUITE_RUN_MODE == 'acceptance' && matrix.architecture == 'x64' && steps.bundled-clang-probe.outcome != 'skipped'"
      shell: pwsh
      run: |
        python -B suite/e2e/vs_bundled_clang_probe.py --validate-report ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath('.work/suite-bundled-clang-probe-public/report.numeric.json'))
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Bundled compiler observation is absent or outside the numeric schema.' }
    - name: Preserve only the closed bundled Clang numeric observation
      if: "always() && env.OPENGEUL_SUITE_RUN_MODE == 'acceptance' && matrix.architecture == 'x64' && steps.bundled-clang-report.outcome == 'success'"
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
      with:
        name: opengeul-bundled-clang-probe-x64-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
        path: .work/suite-bundled-clang-probe-public/report.numeric.json
        retention-days: 1
        if-no-files-found: warn
